segments.name: Bitcoin Mining
segments.description: Operates an enterprise-scale Bitcoin mining business using ASIC miners deployed at hosting sites and a self-owned Iowa facility.
segments.evidence: A key component of the Bitcoin mining business segment is to acquire highly specialized computer servers (known in the industry as "miners"), which operate application-specific integrated circuit ("ASIC") chips designed specifically to mine Bitcoin, and deploy such miners at-scale utilizing our hosting agreements.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by Bitcoin mining pool operators, primarily Foundry Digital LLC, in Bitcoin for providing hash calculation services under Full Pay Per Share arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: In exchange for providing the service, we are entitled to Full Pay Per Share ("FPPS"), which is a fractional share of the fixed Bitcoin award the mining pool operator receives, plus a fractional share of the transaction fees attached to that blockchain less net Bitcoin fees due to the mining pool operator over the measurement period, as applicable.

changes.text: In December 2023, the company sold its service and product segment focused on containerization, virtualization technologies and data management products.
changes.evidence: In December 2023, we sold our service and product segment which focused on containerization and virtualization technologies along with data management products that enabled workload-optimized solutions.
